## Architecture Reflection — Week [N]

`Run this at the end of every week. Write answers in a REFLECTIONS.md`

1. What decision did I make this week that I'd make differently now?
2. What pattern appeared because of pain, not because I chose it in advance?
3. Where did I abstract too early? Where did I wait too long?
4. What type now catches a bug I used to find at runtime?
5. What would break if this feature got 10x more complex?
6. What would break if this codebase had 5 engineers instead of 1?
7. What would a senior engineer change first in my implementation, and why?
